This is original audio for a cozy dark-fantasy comedy, 2D quarter-view castle-defense game. It must be new material, not an imitation of any artist, franchise, existing song, or copyrighted melody.

Compose an original instrumental game soundtrack lasting about 144 seconds. 112 BPM, C minor. Many paths converge on one throne in an expanded single-floor castle. Low strings, dignified horns, measured timpani and sparse bronze accents; interlocking route-like rhythms, mature command and controlled tension that can settle into a reflective epilogue. Develop a complete original 144-second instrumental arc, with compatible opening and final two seconds for a seamless loop. Keep the arrangement readable under frequent combat sound effects. No vocals, spoken words, choir syllables, or recognizable samples. Build a coherent arc without a hard ending. Keep the opening and final two seconds texturally compatible so they can be crossfaded into a seamless loop.
